competitors.name: EasyCargo
competitors.summaryEn: EasyCargo is an established browser-based load planning tool with per-seat licensing (day tickets, monthly or yearly), a 10-day free trial, and support for trucks, containers and pallets.
competitors.summaryZh: EasyCargo 係老牌瀏覽器裝載規劃工具,按席位收費(日票、月費或年費),有 10 日免費試用,支援貨車、貨櫃同卡板。
theyHaveEn: Truck types and pallets as first-class vehicles
Established customer base and long track record
Team/enterprise licensing (enterprise tier from $2,400+ orders)
theyHaveZh: 貨車與卡板類型齊全
老牌產品,客戶基礎成熟
團隊/企業授權(企業級 $2,400+ 起)
competitors.pricingEn: Paid per-seat licenses (day tickets, monthly, yearly; prices shown in their store). Free trial is 10 days.
competitors.pricingZh: 按席位收費(日票/月費/年費,價錢喺佢哋商店顯示),試用期 10 日。

competitors.name: Cargo-Planner
competitors.summaryEn: Cargo-Planner is a polished commercial load planning platform for sea, road and air with an embeddable SDK/API, used by large forwarders and airlines. Pricing is subscription-based via custom tiers.
competitors.summaryZh: Cargo-Planner 係精緻嘅商用裝載規劃平台,覆蓋海運、陸運、空運,提供可嵌入 SDK/API,大型貨代同航空公司都有採用。訂閱制,價錢按方案報價。
theyHaveEn: Air cargo (ULD) support
SDK/API for embedding into your own systems
Enterprise customer base (airlines, global forwarders)
theyHaveZh: 空運 ULD 支援
SDK/API 可嵌入自家系統
企業客戶群(航空公司、全球貨代)
competitors.pricingEn: Subscription plans (quote-based tiers); free trial available.
competitors.pricingZh: 訂閱制(按方案報價),有免費試用。

competitors.name: Cube-IQ
competitors.summaryEn: Cube-IQ (MagicLogic) is enterprise desktop load-optimization software with deep constraint support, frequently cited among the most advanced packers. Third-party listings report pricing from roughly $5,000/year per user.
competitors.summaryZh: Cube-IQ(MagicLogic)係企業級桌面裝載優化軟件,約束支援極深,常被評為最強算法之一。第三方目錄顯示價格約每用戶每年 $5,000 起。
theyHaveEn: Very deep constraint engine (mixed vehicles, complex rules)
Desktop + database integrations for enterprise ops
Decades of enterprise deployments
theyHaveZh: 約束引擎極深(混合載具、複雜規則)
桌面 + 數據庫整合,面向企業營運
數十年企業部署經驗
competitors.pricingEn: Enterprise licensing; third-party listings report from ~$5,000/yr per user (verify with vendor).
competitors.pricingZh: 企業授權;第三方目錄顯示約每用戶每年 $5,000 起(以官方報價為準)。

competitors.name: Goodloading
competitors.summaryEn: Goodloading is a browser-based cargo planning app for road, sea and air. It offers free registration with an always-free demo version and a paid professional tier, and covers axle pressure, permissible total weight and centre of gravity, multi-stop loading, 3D visualisation with a loading animation, and sharing by link or PDF.
competitors.summaryZh: Goodloading 係瀏覽器裝載規劃工具,支援陸運、海運同空運。免費註冊、demo 版一直免費,另有付費專業版;涵蓋軸重、總許可重量同重心、多點裝卸、3D 視覺化連裝載動畫,可用連結或 PDF 分享。
theyHaveEn: Axle pressure, permissible total weight and centre of gravity
Multi-stop loading with cargo separated per drop
Loading animation in shared projects and PDFs
theyHaveZh: 軸重、總許可重量同重心計算
多點裝卸,每個卸貨點分開擺放
分享項目同 PDF 內置裝載動畫
competitors.pricingEn: Free registration with an always-free demo version; a paid professional version adds advanced customisation (prices on their site).
competitors.pricingZh: 免費註冊,demo 版一直免費;付費專業版提供進階自訂功能(價錢見官網)。

competitors.name: 3DBinPacking
competitors.summaryEn: 3DBinPacking is a cloud packing-optimisation service with an API, aimed at box selection and load planning. It offers a 14-day trial with no credit card required, states all tools are included in every subscription plan, and advertises an average calculation time under 0.1 second.
competitors.summaryZh: 3DBinPacking 係雲端裝箱優化服務,附 API,主打選箱同裝載規劃。有 14 日試用、唔使信用卡,聲明所有工具喺每個訂閱方案都包,並標榜平均運算時間少於 0.1 秒。
theyHaveEn: Box-selection tools (find a box size, try out box sizes)
Pallet stacking and max-load checks as separate tools
Established commercial API with published documentation
theyHaveZh: 選箱工具(搵合適箱、試唔同箱)
卡板堆疊同最大裝載檢查獨立工具
成熟商用 API,有正式文檔
competitors.pricingEn: Subscription plans (all tools included in each plan); 14-day trial, no credit card required. Current prices on their site.
competitors.pricingZh: 訂閱制(每個方案都包晒所有工具);14 日試用、唔使信用卡。價錢以官網為準。

competitors.name: CargoWiz
competitors.summaryEn: CargoWiz is a Windows desktop container-loading calculator that positions itself as the easiest to learn. It has a drag-and-drop editor, Excel import, and a "Spread My Cargo" function for weight distribution, with a fully-featured 30-day trial download.
competitors.summaryZh: CargoWiz 係 Windows 桌面貨櫃裝載計算軟件,主打易學易用。有拖放編輯器、Excel 匯入,同埋「Spread My Cargo」重量分佈功能,提供 30 日全功能試用下載。
theyHaveEn: Windows desktop app that runs without a browser or internet
Excel import and a drag-and-drop cargo editor
Fully-featured 30-day trial; support free for the first year
theyHaveZh: Windows 桌面程式,唔使瀏覽器或上網都用得
Excel 匯入 + 拖放式貨物編輯器
30 日全功能試用;首年免費支援
competitors.pricingEn: Paid Windows licence after a 30-day fully-featured trial; the vendor does not publish a price on the product page (verify with vendor).
competitors.pricingZh: 30 日全功能試用後需購買 Windows 授權;官網產品頁未有公開價錢(以官方報價為準)。

competitors.name: CubeMaster
competitors.summaryEn: CubeMaster (Logen Solutions) is a long-established load planning and palletization suite: it cascades cases into pallets and pallets into trucks, containers, rail cars and air ULDs, sold as Windows desktop licences and as CubeMaster Online subscriptions.
competitors.summaryZh: CubeMaster(Logen Solutions)係老牌裝載規劃同砌板軟件:由箱到卡板、由卡板到貨車、貨櫃、火車同航空 ULD 逐層計算,以 Windows 桌面授權同 CubeMaster Online 訂閱形式出售。
theyHaveEn: Case → pallet → vehicle cascade with mixed-size cargo across trucks, containers, rail cars and ULDs
Desktop, online and API editions with an enterprise track record since the 1990s
Palletization patterns and packaging design as first-class features
theyHaveZh: 箱→卡板→車輛逐層計算,支援貨車、貨櫃、火車同 ULD 嘅混合尺寸貨物
桌面版、網上版同 API 版齊備,企業客戶歷史可追溯至 1990 年代
砌板圖案同包裝設計係核心功能
competitors.pricingEn: CubeMaster Online subscriptions are listed from about US$49/month (Standard), with Premium and Collaboration tiers above; desktop perpetual licences are listed from roughly US$995 to US$2,495 per seat. Verify current prices on their pricing page.
competitors.pricingZh: CubeMaster Online 訂閱由約 US$49/月(Standard)起,另有 Premium 同 Collaboration 級別;桌面永久授權每席約 US$995 至 US$2,495。請以佢哋官方價目頁為準。

competitors.name: SeaRates Load Calculator
competitors.summaryEn: SeaRates Load Calculator is the container and truck stuffing tool inside the SeaRates (DP World) freight-rate platform. It is free to try with a daily quota, and paid subscriptions unlock more calculations plus the wider SeaRates logistics toolkit.
competitors.summaryZh: SeaRates Load Calculator 係 SeaRates(DP World)運價平台入面嘅貨櫃同貨車裝載工具。有每日免費配額,付費訂閱解鎖更多計算次數同整套 SeaRates 物流工具。
theyHaveEn: Sits next to live freight rates, tracking and booking in one platform
Cylindrical cargo and palletization options
Backed by DP World with an API for logistics integrations
theyHaveZh: 同即時運價、追蹤同訂艙放喺同一平台
支援圓柱形貨物同砌板選項
由 DP World 支持,提供物流整合 API
competitors.pricingEn: Per SeaRates' own pricing page: unregistered users get 1 free calculation per day; registered users get 20 per month (max 3 per day). Higher volumes need a paid SeaRates subscription (quote-based; 15% discount on annual plans).
competitors.pricingZh: 按 SeaRates 官方價目頁:未登入每日 1 次免費計算;已註冊每月 20 次(每日最多 3 次)。更高用量需要付費訂閱(報價制,年繳有 15% 折扣)。

competitors.name: TOPS Pro
competitors.summaryEn: TOPS Pro (TOPS Engineering) is Windows packaging-design software used by CPG packaging engineers: it sizes primary packs and shipcases, builds pallet patterns, estimates stacking strength and places pallets in trucks.
competitors.summaryZh: TOPS Pro(TOPS Engineering)係消費品包裝工程師常用嘅 Windows 包裝設計軟件:由內包裝同外箱尺寸、砌板圖案、堆疊強度估算,到卡板上車一氣呵成。
theyHaveEn: Full packaging hierarchy: primary pack → shipcase → pallet → truck in one model
Stacking-strength and compression analysis for corrugated design
Decades of adoption in consumer-goods packaging departments
theyHaveZh: 完整包裝層級:內包裝→外箱→卡板→貨車一個模型搞掂
針對紙箱設計嘅堆疊強度同抗壓分析
消費品包裝部門幾十年嘅採用歷史
competitors.pricingEn: The vendor does not publish prices; third-party software directories list TOPS Pro as quote-based licensing with a free trial on request. Contact TOPS Engineering for a quote.
competitors.pricingZh: 廠商唔公開價錢;第三方軟件目錄列為報價制授權,可申請試用。請直接向 TOPS Engineering 索取報價。

competitors.name: StackBuilder
competitors.summaryEn: StackBuilder is treeDiM's Windows palletizing and case-packing tool, part of the PLMPack packaging suite: it generates pallet patterns and truck loads from case dimensions and is popular with packaging engineers who want a desktop workflow.
competitors.summaryZh: StackBuilder 係 treeDiM 嘅 Windows 砌板同裝箱工具,屬 PLMPack 包裝套件一部分:由箱尺寸生成砌板圖案同貨車裝載,深受想用桌面流程嘅包裝工程師歡迎。
theyHaveEn: Detailed palletizing patterns (interlocking, column, pinwheel) with case-packing analysis
Integrates with the Picador CAD suite for packaging design drawings
Desktop, offline workflow with no per-calculation quota
theyHaveZh: 詳細砌板圖案(交錯、直排、風車)連裝箱分析
同 Picador CAD 套件整合,可出包裝設計圖
桌面離線流程,冇計算次數限制
competitors.pricingEn: treeDiM publishes StackBuilder as a free Windows download; the wider PLMPack/Picador CAD suite is commercial and quote-based per third-party listings. Verify current terms with treeDiM.
competitors.pricingZh: treeDiM 以免費 Windows 下載形式發佈 StackBuilder;整套 PLMPack/Picador CAD 套件為商業報價制(據第三方目錄)。請向 treeDiM 核實最新條款。

competitors.name: PackApp
competitors.summaryEn: PackApp is a load planning application for trailers, containers and railcars that suggests one or more load plans from a packing list, including paper rolls, pallets and skids, and exposes a REST API for ERP/TMS integration.
competitors.summaryZh: PackApp 係針對拖車、貨櫃同火車車廂嘅裝載規劃應用,由裝箱單建議一個或多個裝載方案,支援紙卷、卡板同滑板,並提供 REST API 整合 ERP/TMS。
theyHaveEn: Paper rolls, skids and pallets alongside boxes, with centre-of-gravity output
Picks the smallest suitable container and only proposes high-cube, open-top or flat-rack when needed
REST API for automatic ERP/TMS linking
theyHaveZh: 除箱之外支援紙卷、滑板同卡板,並輸出重心
自動揀最細合用貨櫃,只喺必要時建議高櫃、開頂或平板櫃
REST API 自動連接 ERP/TMS
competitors.pricingEn: The vendor does not publish prices publicly; third-party listings describe subscription licensing on request. Contact PackApp for a quote.
competitors.pricingZh: 廠商未公開價錢;第三方目錄描述為按需訂閱授權。請向 PackApp 索取報價。
